name: American Financial Group, Inc.
summary:
American Financial Group (AFG) reported earnings of $2.82 per share on revenue of $2.03 billion for the second quarter ended June 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $2.41 per share on revenue of $1.94 billion. The company beat consensus estimates by 17.01% while revenue grew 5.51% on a year-over-year basis.

American Financial Group Inc is a holding company. The Company through its subsidiaries is engaged in property and casualty insurance, and in the sale of fixed and fixed-indexed annuities in the retail, financial institutions and education markets.
subject: American Financial Group Beat Consensus Estimates
